property_summary: A single collectDrugs call may increase the caller's Kilos by at most the pre-call Kilos value (since production is kilos*elapsed/86400 with elapsed capped at 86400, i.e., kilos at most double per collect); the mutant adds the raw drug amount (up to 86400x the kilos), far exceeding that bound.
change_summary: Replace the newKilo computation with the raw drugsUsed value, so the entire accumulated drug amount (not drugs/86400) is added to Kilos.
